name: Tatoeba Challenge
description: Multi-parallel translation benchmark derived from the Tatoeba collection of user-contributed translations. Covers 500+ language pairs with pre-built train/dev/test splits. Sentences are short, conversational, and contributed by volunteer translators worldwide.

source.publisher: Tatoeba community / OPUS / University of Helsinki
source.citation: Tiedemann (2020). The Tatoeba Translation Challenge — Realistic Data Sets for Low Resource and Multilingual MT.

license.aiTraining: Permitted under CC-BY-2.0. Attribution to Tatoeba required.
license.notes: Individual sentences may have different licenses. The CC-BY-2.0 applies to the collection as distributed by the Tatoeba Challenge.

segments.name: Test
segments.purpose: Held-out test set. Size varies by language pair (typically 100-10,000 sentences). Size varies by language pair (typically 100-10,000 sentences).

segments.name: Development
segments.purpose: Development set for tuning. Size varies by pair. Size varies by language pair (typically 100-10,000 sentences).

download.instructions: Download per-pair data packages from the GitHub repository. Each pair has its own directory with train/dev/test splits.

contamination.reasoning: Tatoeba sentences are publicly available and widely crawled. Some appear in OPUS training data used by Helsinki-NLP models. Individual sentences likely appear in web-crawled training data for frontier models, but the specific challenge splits are less commonly targeted.

_provenance.populatedFrom: Tatoeba Challenge GitHub repository (https://github.com/Helsinki-NLP/Tatoeba-Challenge), paper (arXiv:2010.06354). Language list is a representative subset — full list has 500+ languages.
